note: Ratchet baseline for the host-assumption guard.  These entries are PRE-EXISTING: absolute-path literals in tests that are deliberate inputs (a path that must be rejected) and capability uses that already skip.  The gate fails on anything NEW, so a new absolute path or an un-skipped capability use must be fixed rather than silently added.  The identity is rule|relative_path|FULL_VALUE, so entries are exact.
